findings.claim: The type prefixFlag is now reused for --key but keeps its topic-prefix name; the comment was updated while the name was not, so `var keys prefixFlag` reads misleadingly.

Resolve issues one query per key with no transaction, so a many-key call does N round trips and the answers do not come from one consistent snapshot if an import runs concurrently. Not a correctness defect for typical use.

A missing or empty --source and an empty --key are only detected after opening the service, so a usage error needs a working store. Validation could happen in the CLI before Run opens the database, which would give exit 2 even when the store is unavailable.

evidence: Reviewed all six changed paths in the diff. Resolve reads only import_map (part = 1) and writes nothing; the text and JSON output match the documented formats, and null memory_id is produced via a pointer. Usage errors exit 2 with the usage line. No behavior defect found; only readability and minor robustness notes.
